segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so thanks for making time, Dana. I had you at 42 current seats, and it sounds like finance wants to add the regional managers before the June close. Is that still the plan?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Mostly. We counted again yesterday and it is 47 total users, not 50. Twelve of those are read-only if that matters for pricing.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: It does. On the pricing sheet, full users are $86 per seat per month on annual, and read-only are $24. So 35 full and 12 read-only puts the annual at $39,816 before tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that is in the range. We need the invoice to hit after May 15, though. Our PO opens that week.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, we can set the subscription start to June 1 and invoice on May 16. Payment terms stay net 30 unless procurement needs something different.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Net 30 is fine. One thing, implementation. We want the first team live by June 17. Is that realistic?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, if we do kickoff the week of June 3. The onboarding package includes two admin sessions and one end-user training. For 47 users, that is enough unless you want a second end-user session.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Let's add the second end-user session. The managers will be split across Central and Mountain time.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Sure. That adds $750 one-time. I’ll include both sessions on the order form so services has the dates and time zones when they schedule it.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. Contract length is still 12 months?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct, June 1, 2026 through May 31, 2027. Annual billing, net 30, 35 full seats, 12 read-only, and the extra training session.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Send it over today and I’ll route it with the PO request. If the total matches what you just said, I don’t expect drama.
